acceptanceEvidence: src/domains/purchasing/purchases.ts recordPurchase writes the Purchase, every Appliance (own model, serial, price, purchaseId), PurchaseDocument pages and per-appliance acquisition-tax evidence in one transaction; the record-a-purchase screen (src/app/desk/purchases/new) takes the supplier or typed private seller, date, receipt number, uploads, delivery/other charges and notes; the supplier page lists purchases. tests/purchases-w14-w2-w15-integration.test.ts proves the linked 3-appliance receipt with exact totals; PDF/photo pages upload privately under purchases/.

Record a purchase replaces the old intake form and action (removed); a washer and dryer are two grid rows with their own type, manufacturer, model, serial, price, condition and color; real-Postgres test records a washer, dryer and unit on one receipt with distinct asset numbers.

purchase-math.ts splitSellerTax uses allocateAcrossLines (largest remainder) and reconcilePurchase proves prices + tax + other charges to the cent against optional typed receipt subtotal/total; the form shows the split before saving and the server recomputes it. tests/purchase-math-and-next-step.test.ts (26) and the real-DB test (101 cents over three unequal prices sums to 101) pass.

taxAnswer has no default for the owner; YES_OTHER_STATE stores a state note, calculates nothing, and creates a CPA To do (integration test 'another state's tax'); validation tests refuse taxed answers without tax and tax on no-tax answers.

Appliance.purchaseId links each machine; seller page lists purchases; recordPurchase/read pages are OWNER/ADMIN (requireRole + assertActiveTeamActor, STAFF/CUSTOMER refused for uploads and receipt reads, tests/private-photo-read-route.test.ts); operationKey+payloadHash replay and conflict tests plus a simultaneous double-submit test; updatePurchaseTaxAnswer after a filed return keeps filed rows and detectTaxFilingAmendments opens the amendment (real-DB test).

src/domains/tax/next-step.ts nextPurchaseTaxStep is the single pure decision; tests/purchase-math-and-next-step.test.ts has a table per answer: full seller tax done, use tax on the covering return with the calendar's legal due date, no filing account, filed with confirmation, tax-free for rent taxed, another state CPA To do, later To do.

Later To do is due 3 days after recording and severity turns high 7 days before the covering return's legal due date (tests on Nov 12 medium / Nov 13 high); record result card, purchase page, appliance Tax proof, PO receiving page and listAcquisitionTaxAttention all render the same step object.

Due dates come only from filing-calendar/stored TaxFilingPeriod via coveringUseTaxReturn; purchase-order receiving asks the same four-way question (receipt-tax.ts, receiving panel), creates PURCHASE_ORDER_LINE use-tax rows, and the owner can answer later; real-DB test covers admin-defers/owner-answers with the To do appearing and clearing.

src/app/desk/inventory/[id]/tax-proof-panel.tsx (owner/admin) shows how acquired, price paid, exactly one tax outcome from nextPurchaseTaxStep, seller tax or use tax with return and confirmation, and receipt links; getApplianceTaxProof tested for the filed-return case.

src/domains/tax/tax-proof.ts buildAuditPack + /desk/tax/audit-pack printable page + /desk/tax/audit-pack/export CSV with a stable 19-column order through the shared formula-safe toCsv; both gated to OWNER/ADMIN; real-DB test checks range filter, serial, price, tax, receipt link and totals; unit test locks column order and formula escaping.

Parts deliveries join the pack line by line; recordRetentionYears defaults to 7 with an ⓘ explanation, owner-only compare-and-set audited editor (/desk/tax/record-retention); removePurchaseDocument refuses any purchase relied on by a filed return and the only page within the retention period, and PurchaseDocument.photo is ON DELETE RESTRICT (real-DB test attempts a direct photo delete).

externalAcceptance: IN-65: CPA answers on credits, another state's tax and delivery-charge tax; until then those cases only create a CPA To do.
IN-71: CPA confirms the record-retention period; the app starts at 7 years and the owner can change it.
Real receipts, purchases and filed returns still need owner use after the daily release.
